periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation with the superior-lateral edge higher than the inferior-medial edge, creating a roughly 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal eye line.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.6:1, appearing as an elongated teardrop.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering where the patch narrows toward the muzzle, placing the bulk of the pigment mass above the geometric midpoint.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior edge with a smooth, non-angular transition across the spinal column.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band is approximately 25% of the visible dorsal length, maintaining consistent width from the spine to the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide gap of white fur separating the pinnae, approximately 1.2 times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and semicircular with high-frequency curvature at the superior boundary.
